lines: By whose opening and closing the worlds dissolve and rise —
to him, power-wheel-glory's source: praise, Śaṅkara.
sanskrit_cite: yasyonmeṣanimeṣābhyāṃ jagataḥ pralayodayau | taṃ śakticakravibhavaprabhavaṃ śaṅkaraṃ stumaḥ

lines: Where all this effect abides, and whence it issued forth —
from being uncovered-formed, no obstruction anywhere.
sanskrit_cite: yatra sthitam idaṃ sarvaṃ kāryaṃ yasmāc ca nirgataṃ | tasyānāvṛtarūpatvān na nirodho 'sti kutracit

lines: Even in waking-difference, it glides in the undifferent;
the perceiver never turns back from its own being.
sanskrit_cite: jāgradādi vibhede 'pi tadabhinne prasarpati | nivartate nijānnaiva svabhāvād upalabdhṛtaḥ

lines: I happy, I suffering, I attached and the like —
those awarenesses abide elsewhere, pleasure-strung, plain to sight.
sanskrit_cite: ahaṃ sukhī ca duḥkhī ca raktaś ca ityadisamvidaḥ | sukhādyavasthānusyūte vartante 'nyatra tāḥ sphuṭam

lines: Where no pleasure is, no pain, no grasped, no grasper found,
nor even delusion — THAT is, on ultimate ground.
sanskrit_cite: na duḥkhaṃ na sukhaṃ yatra na grāhyam grāhakaṃ na ca | na cāsti mūḍhabhāvo 'pi tad asti paramārthataḥ

lines: Since the sense-host, deluded, thinks itself undeluded still —
forthgoing, standing, dissolving, by the inner wheel.
sanskrit_cite: yataḥ karaṇavargo 'yaṃ vimūḍho 'mūḍhavat svayam | sahāntareṇa cakreṇa pravṛttisthitisaṃhṛtiḥ
